extDescription.message: Full-window theater mode, dislike counts, automatic quality and codec selection for YouTube.

statusNoVideo.message: No YouTube video is playing in this tab.

optFullWindow.message: Full page (player fills the window height)

reveal_hover.message: When the mouse reaches the top

reveal_both.message: On mouse hover and after scrolling

optAutoTheater.message: Start videos in theater mode automatically

hintDislikes.message: Counts are provided by Return YouTube Dislike (returnyoutubedislikeapi.com). To get them, the service receives the ID of every video you open and your IP address. Turn the module off if you don’t want that.

hintDislikesShort.message: Dislike count: the video ID goes to returnyoutubedislikeapi.com, which sees your IP address.

welcomeDislikes.message: The Dislike count module is on. Counts come from Return YouTube Dislike (returnyoutubedislikeapi.com): it receives only the ID of the video you open, and like any server it sees your IP address. You can turn it off now, or any time later with its switch below.

needOneVideoCodec.message: At least one video codec must stay enabled.

needOneAudioCodec.message: At least one audio codec must stay enabled.

optShortsRedirect.message: Open Shorts in the regular player

hintHideShorts.message: With the option above enabled, every link to a Short opens as a regular video in the standard player.

resetConfirm.message: Really restore all settings to their defaults?

importFailed.message: The file could not be read. Is it a valid HeMiTube export?

savedReload.message: Saved. The change takes effect after reloading the YouTube page.

optNoAmbient.message: Turn off the ambient glow around the video

sbPermissionDenied.message: Without access to SponsorBlock, sponsors can’t be skipped.

distCards.message: Info cards, watermark and the paid promotion notice
